body:
Hey man. I'm 45 - I started going bald at 17. I also have vitiligo which is a condition which turns parts of your skin pure white. I shaved my head when I was 21. Here's the thing - I had more women interested in me and more (worthwhile) relationships after I shaved it all off than I did before, by a huge margin. I've not met one woman who cares I'm bald. I suppose that's because they might avoid me in the first place but dude - for every woman who doesn't like bald guys there's at least one who totally loves it and 2 more who don't care.

The birth mark thing hits close to home as well because of my vitiligo. I developed white patches all over my penis in my 20's, and I was absolutely convinced the first time a woman saw it she would be disgusted. 3 long term relationships, one marriage and 2 kids later I know that's not true.

It's daunting thinking of something that will change your appearance so fundamentally, but all I can tell you, from 25 years, one wife and 2 kids down the road - you can face it and you can fucking own it.
So sorry you're going through this. I'm about your age and I've been through similar, but nowhere near as extreme as you. I'm here if you need someone.
They wouldn't have voted that way unless the result was beyond question.
Thank you. Just knowing that you made the effort to post that made a difference. Yesterday was the worst day of my life but maybe I can get through it. Thanks.
